purpose: Determine whether the deferred aggregate NPL response equation has a definitionally complete Romania source boundary before any risk-model estimation.

exact_risk_source.concept: Gross non-performing loans and advances as percent of total gross loans and advances, domestic banks, FINREP reporters, Romania
exact_risk_source.coverage: 2014-Q4 to 2025-Q3 in the indexed ECB Data Portal evidence reviewed on 2026-09-19
exact_risk_source.semantic_limit: The aggregate banking-system NPL ratio is a stock-quality outcome affected by recognition, cures, write-offs, sales and portfolio composition; it is not a pure borrower-default incidence measure.

sector_specific_npl_family.evidence: CBD2 publishes I3632 with counterpart-sector breakdowns such as S11 in the same consolidated-banking framework.
sector_specific_npl_family.rule: Do not choose aggregate versus NFC/household NPL target after viewing model performance. A future target-boundary contract must freeze the portfolio before estimation.

available_but_non_equivalent_sources.concept: Quarterly loan stocks and financial transactions for households/NFCs
available_but_non_equivalent_sources.why_not_debt_service: Stocks and net loan transactions do not identify scheduled principal repayments plus interest service on the same borrower boundary.

available_but_non_equivalent_sources.why_not_use_proxy: Country coverage or total-private-sector measures may not be silently substituted for an exact Romania household/NFC debt-service burden.

debt_service_boundary.prohibited_measurement_model: Do not synthesize debt service as debt stock times a lending rate plus assumed amortisation/maturity without a separately preregistered measurement model and independent validation.

output_growth_boundary.rule: The activity variable must be selected ex ante on the same target/portfolio boundary before fit; aggregate GDP and NFC GVA are not interchangeable.

lag_and_stock_dynamics.rho_NPL_lag_role: The lagged NPL ratio is mechanically observable once the target series is fixed, but including rho does not resolve causal identification.
lag_and_stock_dynamics.recognition_delay: NPL recognition and supervisory/accounting changes may create delays or breaks; lag order must be preregistered, not selected from holdout performance.
lag_and_stock_dynamics.boundary_2014_note: The harmonised FINREP/EBA-era quarterly series begins in 2014-Q4 in the retained ECB evidence and should not be silently concatenated with older national definitions.

reasons: The NPL target is observed exactly, but debt_service_burden is not retained on a definitionally matched borrower/portfolio boundary.
The output-growth observable is not frozen.
Aggregate versus sector-specific NPL target is not frozen for the future candidate family.
Lag structure and treatment of regulatory/portfolio-management breaks are not preregistered.
source_admissibility.reduced_form_rule: Dropping debt service or estimating an output-plus-lag equation because debt service is unavailable requires a new preregistered candidate-family contract and independent evaluation design.

prohibited_shortcuts: Construct debt service from loan stock multiplied by a new-business lending rate.
Assume an amortisation schedule or average maturity to manufacture principal service.
Use loan transactions as principal repayments.
Use debt-to-income or debt-to-GDP as a debt-service burden.
Choose aggregate versus sector-specific NPL after model fit.
Concatenate pre-2014 national NPL definitions with the harmonised FINREP series without an explicit bridge.
Drop the debt-service term and fit a nested model without preregistration.
